description: This file defines the implementation of trigger configuration functions for BMW engines within a mechanical or automotive ECU firmware. It specifically contains code to configure trigger shape patterns for BMW mini cooper engines, including adding trigger events and setting synchronization flags.

classes.name: TriggerShape
classes.description: Represents the shape and trigger pattern of engine timing signals, with methods to add trigger events and initialize trigger properties.

methods.name: void configureMiniCooperTriggerShape(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Configures the trigger shape pattern for a Mini Cooper engine, adding events and setting synchronization properties.
